pick.headline: Vietnamese forces take Phnom Penh
pick.summary: On 7 January 1979 Vietnamese troops and Cambodian rebels captured Phnom Penh, ending the Khmer Rouge regime of Pol Pot.
pick.significance: The invasion ended a regime responsible for mass killing but installed a Hanoi-backed government that China, ASEAN and the US refused to recognize. Weeks later China attacked Vietnam.
